# Changelog

The full history is in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/s00d/onlinesim-swift-api/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md){rel="&#x22;nofollow&#x22;"}.

## 1.0.1

- Fixed decoding against the current API: optional `NumberOperation.response` (`waitCode` no longer polls until its timeout), nullable payment and free-list fields, `Profile.number`/`country` types, `RentSms.code` `"0"` for `notify` SMS; `paymentHistory().paylist` is kept when it arrives as a list.
- `waitCode` retries `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (rate limit), `ERROR_UNDEFINED` and `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`.
- `MockOnlineSim` follows the backend more closely: rent reservation and confirmation, `setOperationRevise` and `closeRentNum` answers, missing vs wrong key — see [Testing](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-swift-api/testing).

## 1.0.0

First release of the Swift SDK, on the same contract as the other OnlineSim SDKs (JS 2.1.0, PHP, Python, Go, Rust, Java, Ruby, .NET).

- `OnlineSimClient` with `numbers`, `rent`, `user` and `free` sections; `async throws` methods; `Sendable` everywhere (Swift 6 language mode ready).
- Swift 5.9+, macOS 12, iOS 15, tvOS 15, watchOS 8, Linux; zero dependencies (`URLSession`).
- The key is sent as a Bearer header, never in the URL; injectable `Transport` (your own `URLSession`).
- One error enum, `OnlineSimError`: `.api`, `.noNumber`, `.transport`, `.waitTimeout`, `.invalidPayload`.
- `numbers.waitCode`: interval and timeout in seconds, `keepOpen`, `since`, retries network errors, injectable `WaitClock`.
- `parseWebhook` for inbound webhooks; webhook URL set / clear / logs.
- `MockOnlineSim`: an offline fake of the API for your tests — see [Testing](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-swift-api/testing).


# Free numbers

## list

Countries, the numbers of the selected country and the SMS of the selected number, in one call.

```swift
func list(country: Int? = nil, number: String? = nil, page: Int? = nil, count: Int? = nil) async throws -> FreeList
```

| Param     | Type      | Default        | Description                                                     |
| --------- | --------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `country` | `Int?`    | `44` (server)  | Country code; an unknown one falls back to the first available. |
| `number`  | `String?` | first number   | Number **without** the country code, as the keys of `numbers`.  |
| `page`    | `Int?`    | `1`            | Page of `messages`.                                             |
| `count`   | `Int?`    | server default | SMS per page, 10–500.                                           |

`FreeList`:

- `countries`: `[FreeCountry]` — `country`, `countryText?`, `countryOriginal?` (`nil` when the server has none)
- `numbers`: `[String: FreeNumber]` — `country`, `countryOriginal?`, `fullNumber`, `dataHumans`, `isArchive`; keyed by the short number
- `messages`: `FreeMessages` — `page` (a `Paginator<FreeMessage>`), `data` (its items), `number`, `country`; `FreeMessage` has `id`, `text`, `inNumber`, `myNumber`, `code`, `createdAt`, `dataHumans`; `code` is `-` when no code was found

```swift
let numbers = try await client.free.list(country: 44).numbers
if let short = numbers.keys.sorted().first {
    let messages = try await client.free.list(country: 44, number: short, count: 20).messages
    for sms in messages.data { print(sms.inNumber, sms.code, sms.text) }
}
```


# Numbers

An operation (`tzid`) is one ordered number. Order it with `get`/`getWithNumber`, read the SMS with `stateOne` or `waitCode`, finish it with `close` (or `ban`). Countries are phone codes (`7`, `44`, …), services are slugs (`google`, `vkcom`, …) as returned by `tariffs`. Every method is `async throws`.

## price

Price of one number, USD; `nil` when the country has no price for the service.

```swift
func price(_ service: String, country: Int = 7) async throws -> Double?
```

| Param     | Type     | Default | Description   |
| --------- | -------- | ------- | ------------- |
| `service` | `String` | —       | Service slug. |
| `country` | `Int`    | `7`     | Country code. |

```swift
let usd = try await client.numbers.price("google", country: 44)
```

Errors: `.api` `ERROR_NO_SERVICE`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`.

## get

Order a number; returns the operation id. Freezes the price on the balance.

```swift
func get(_ service: String, country: Int = 7, reject: [String] = []) async throws -> Int
```

| Param     | Type       | Default      | Description                               |
| --------- | ---------- | ------------ | ----------------------------------------- |
| `service` | `String`   | —            | Service slug.                             |
| `country` | `Int`      | `7`          | Country code.                             |
| `reject`  | `[String]` | profile list | Number prefixes to skip, e.g. `["4470"]`. |

```swift
let tzid = try await client.numbers.get("google", country: 44, reject: ["4470"])
```

Errors: `.noNumber`; `.api` `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `ERROR_NO_SERVICE`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`, `EXCEEDED_CONCURRENT_OPERATIONS`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## getWithNumber

Same as `get`, but returns the number right away.

```swift
func getWithNumber(_ service: String, country: Int = 7, reject: [String] = []) async throws -> NumberOrder
```

`NumberOrder`: `tzid`, `number` (with `+`), `country`, `time` (seconds left), `service`, `title?`, `guardIntervalRemainingSeconds?`.

```swift
let order = try await client.numbers.getWithNumber("google", country: 44)
print(order.tzid, order.number)
```

Errors: as `get`.

## state

All operations of the account; empty when there are none.

```swift
func state(messageToCode: Bool = true, orderBy: OrderBy = .asc, msgList: Bool = false) async throws -> [NumberOperation]
```

| Param           | Type      | Default | Description                                          |
| --------------- | --------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------- |
| `messageToCode` | `Bool`    | `true`  | `msg` is the code only; `false` — the full SMS text. |
| `orderBy`       | `OrderBy` | `.asc`  | Order of operations (`.asc`, `.desc`).               |
| `msgList`       | `Bool`    | `false` | `msg` is a list of all SMS.                          |

`NumberOperation`: `tzid`, `response?`, `number?`, `service?`, `country?`, `sum?`, `time?`, `msg?`, `guardIntervalRemainingSeconds?`, …
`response` is an `OperationStatus` (`nil` when the server sends none: no number could be issued): `.tzInPool` (number being assigned), `.tzNumWait` (waiting for SMS), `.tzNumAnswer` (SMS arrived), `.tzOverOk` (finished), `.errorNoItems` (failed). `msg` is an `OperationMessage` — `.text(String)` by default, `.list([OperationSms])` with `msgList` — and `nil` until the first SMS. The server caches answers for a few seconds.

```swift
for op in try await client.numbers.state(orderBy: .desc) {
    print(op.tzid, op.response?.rawValue ?? "-", op.msg?.text ?? "-")
}
```

## stateOne

One operation.

```swift
func stateOne(_ tzid: Int, messageToCode: Bool = true, msgList: Bool = false) async throws -> NumberOperation
```

```swift
let op = try await client.numbers.stateOne(tzid)
if op.response == .tzNumAnswer { print(op.msg?.text ?? "") }
```

Errors: `.api` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` when the operation does not exist (any more).

## waitCode

Poll the operation until a code arrives, then close it and return the code.

```swift
func waitCode(
    _ tzid: Int,
    interval: TimeInterval = 5,
    timeout: TimeInterval = 600,
    keepOpen: Bool = false,
    fullMessage: Bool = false,
    since: String? = nil,
    clock: WaitClock = .system
) async throws -> String
```

| Param         | Type           | Default   | Description                                                          |
| ------------- | -------------- | --------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `interval`    | `TimeInterval` | `5`       | Poll interval, seconds.                                              |
| `timeout`     | `TimeInterval` | `600`     | Give up after, seconds.                                              |
| `keepOpen`    | `Bool`         | `false`   | Call `next(tzid)` instead of `close(tzid)`, to wait for another SMS. |
| `fullMessage` | `Bool`         | `false`   | Return the full SMS text instead of the code.                        |
| `since`       | `String?`      | `nil`     | Ignore this value (the previous code).                               |
| `clock`       | `WaitClock`    | `.system` | `now` and `sleep`; inject a fake one in tests.                       |

Transient errors are retried until the timeout: `.transport`, and `.api` `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (the HTTP 429 rate limit), `ERROR_UNDEFINED` and `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`. Any other API error is thrown at once. Task cancellation stops the wait.

```swift
let first = try await client.numbers.waitCode(tzid, keepOpen: true)
let second = try await client.numbers.waitCode(tzid, since: first)
```

Errors: `.waitTimeout`; `.api` with code `TZ_OVER_OK` or `ERROR_NO_ITEMS` when the operation ended without a new code; any other API error from `stateOne`/`close`/`next`.

A fake clock for tests: nothing really waits.

```swift
import OnlineSim

let instant = WaitClock(now: { 0 }, sleep: { _ in })
let code = try await client.numbers.waitCode(tzid, clock: instant)
```

## next

Switch the operation to its next SMS and keep it open (for services that send several SMS).

```swift
func next(_ tzid: Int) async throws
```

```swift
try await client.numbers.next(tzid)
```

Errors: `.api` `ERROR_WRONG_TZID` (not an operation of your account), `ERROR_NO_TZID`.

## close

Finish the operation. An operation without SMS can be closed only after its guard interval (`guardIntervalRemainingSeconds`); every attempt locks the tzid for 5 s.

```swift
func close(_ tzid: Int) async throws
```

```swift
try await client.numbers.close(tzid)
```

Errors: `.api` `NO_COMPLETE_TZID`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `ERROR_WRONG_TZID`.

## ban

Finish the operation and report the number as bad. Only before any SMS arrived.

```swift
func ban(_ tzid: Int) async throws
```

```swift
try await client.numbers.ban(tzid)
```

Errors: as `close`; `.api` with code `"0"` when the operation already has an SMS — nothing is changed then.

## tariffs

Services, prices and stock of every country, keyed by country code. No API key needed. The answer is large (a few MB); prefer `tariffsOne`.

```swift
func tariffs() async throws -> [Int: CountryStat]
```

`CountryStat`: `name`, `localeName?`, `position`, `code`, `other?`, `isNew`, `isEnabled`, `services`; `services` maps `service_<slug>` to `ServiceStat` (`count?`, `isPopular`, `code`, `price`, `id`, `service`, `slug`). `count` is `nil` when the server does not know the stock.

```swift
let all = try await client.numbers.tariffs()
print(all.count, "countries")
```

## tariffsOne

Services, prices and stock of one country.

```swift
func tariffsOne(country: Int = 7) async throws -> CountryStat
```

```swift
let uk = try await client.numbers.tariffsOne(country: 44)
for service in uk.services.values { print(service.slug, service.price, service.count ?? 0) }
```

Errors: `.api` `NO_COUNTRY`.


# Rent

A rent keeps a number for `days` days. Its SMS come in `RentItem.messages`, newest first.

`get` reserves the price (it shows in `zbalance`): the rent starts with `status` `0` and `checked` `false` and waits up to 20 minutes for its first SMS. The first SMS that is not a `notify` notice confirms it (`status` `1`) and charges the price; without one the rent closes and the reservation is released. Some countries (`confirm` in `tariffs`, e.g. US numbers) are confirmed and charged at once.

`RentItem`: `tzid`, `status`, `number`, `country`, `sum`, `days`, `hours`, `time`, `timeSeconds?`, `extension`, `extend`, `messages`, `startTime`, `stopTime`, `dayExtend?`, … —
`sum` is the cost in USD incl. extensions (a `Double`; the server sends a number, or a decimal string in `state`), `time` minutes left, `timeSeconds` seconds left,
`extension` `0` not extendable / `1` extendable / `2` auto-extension, `extend` maps days to the extension price (`[Int: Double]`, empty when not extendable),
`messages` is `[RentSms]`: `id`, `service`, `text`, `code`, `createdAt` — `code` is `""` when no code was found and `"0"` for a `notify` SMS (a prohibited sender; the server sends the integer `0`).

## get

Rent a number. The price is reserved; the first SMS charges it.

```swift
func get(country: Int = 7, days: Int = 1, extension: Bool = true) async throws -> RentItem
```

| Param       | Type   | Default | Description                                     |
| ----------- | ------ | ------- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| `country`   | `Int`  | `7`     | Country code.                                   |
| `days`      | `Int`  | `1`     | One of the tariff's `days` keys.                |
| `extension` | `Bool` | `true`  | `false` makes the rent non-extendable for good. |

```swift
let rent = try await client.rent.get(country: 7, days: 7)
print(rent.tzid, rent.number, rent.sum)
```

Errors: `.noNumber`; `.api` `UNDEFINED_DAYS`, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY`, `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`, `INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## state

All rents of the account.

```swift
func state() async throws -> [RentItem]
```

```swift
for rent in try await client.rent.state() {
    print(rent.number, rent.messages.first?.code ?? "-")
}
```

## stateOne

One rent.

```swift
func stateOne(_ tzid: Int) async throws -> RentItem
```

```swift
let messages = try await client.rent.stateOne(tzid).messages
```

Errors: `.api` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` for an unknown tzid.

## extend

Extend a rent by `days` days and charge the balance at once. Only confirmed rents (`status` `1` or `4`) created with `extension: true`.

```swift
func extend(_ tzid: Int, days: Int = 1) async throws -> RentItem
```

```swift
let rent = try await client.rent.extend(tzid, days: 3)
print(rent.stopTime)
```

Errors: `.api` `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` (unknown tzid, not confirmed yet or closed, not extendable, unknown period, a repeat within 10 s), `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE`.

## close

Return the number before the period ends. A rent that is not confirmed yet (`status` `0`) and has no SMS can be closed only after 120 s; then, or with only `notify` SMS, the reservation is released. With a real SMS the rent is confirmed (charged) and closed. A confirmed rent closes without a refund. US numbers cannot be closed early.

```swift
func close(_ tzid: Int) async throws
```

```swift
try await client.rent.close(tzid)
```

Errors: `.api` `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS`, `NO_COMPLETE_TZID`, `NO_CLOSE_RENT_US`, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER`.

## tariffs

Rent prices of every country, keyed by country code. No API key needed.

```swift
func tariffs() async throws -> [Int: RentTariff]
```

`RentTariff`: `code`, `name`, `isEnabled`, `isNew`, `position`, `extend`, `confirm?`, `days`, `count`, `extCounts?` — `days` maps rent days to the price in USD, `count` to the numbers available.

```swift
let tariffs = try await client.rent.tariffs()
```

## tariffsOne

Rent prices of one country.

```swift
func tariffsOne(country: Int = 7) async throws -> RentTariff
```

```swift
let tariff = try await client.rent.tariffsOne(country: 7)
print(tariff.days[7] ?? 0) // price of 7 days
```

Errors: `.api` `NO_COUNTRY` for a country without rent.


# Testing

`MockOnlineSim` is an in-process fake of the OnlineSim API that ships with the package. It is a `Transport` that answers like the real backend — same shapes, same error codes, HTTP 456 for a wrong key (HTTP 200 `ERROR_WRONG_KEY` for none) — and keeps a balance, operations and rents. Your code talks to a normal `OnlineSimClient`, so nothing in it changes for tests. It is deterministic: no randomness, no clock, numbers and ids come from a counter.

## Setup

```swift
import OnlineSim

let mock = MockOnlineSim(balance: 10)
let client = mock.client() // an OnlineSimClient wired to the mock
```

```swift
init(
    apiKey: String = "mock-key",
    balance: Double = 100,                                       // USD
    prices: [Int: [String: Double]] = MockOnlineSim.defaultPrices, // country → service → USD
    rentTariffs: [Int: MockRentTariff] = MockOnlineSim.defaultRentTariffs,
    guardInterval: Int = 0                                       // seconds
)
```

| Parameter       | Default                                                                                   | Description                                                                                                     |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `apiKey`        | `"mock-key"`                                                                              | Key the mock accepts. `mock.client()` uses it; `mock.client(apiKey: "x")` tests a wrong key.                    |
| `balance`       | `100`                                                                                     | Starting balance, USD.                                                                                          |
| `prices`        | `[7: ["vkcom": 0.5, "telegram": 1.2, "google": 0.3], 44: ["google": 0.2, "vkcom": 0.36]]` | Number prices; replace the defaults. Also feed `numbers.tariffs()`.                                             |
| `rentTariffs`   | `[7: MockRentTariff(days: [1: 1, 3: 2.5, 7: 5], extend: 1)]`                              | Rent prices; `extend: 0` makes rents of that country non-extendable.                                            |
| `guardInterval` | `0`                                                                                       | `> 0`: an operation without SMS, or an unconfirmed rent without any SMS, cannot be closed (`NO_COMPLETE_TZID`). |

`mock.client(apiKey:lang:devID:timeout:)` takes the usual [client options](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-swift-api/#client-options) except `baseURL` and `transport`. To build the client yourself, pass `mock.transport` (the mock itself) as `transport`; any `baseURL` works:

```swift
import OnlineSim

let mock = MockOnlineSim()
let client = OnlineSimClient(apiKey: "mock-key", transport: mock.transport)
```

`MockOnlineSim` is a `Sendable` final class: its state is one value behind one lock, so the helpers below are synchronous and the mock can serve concurrent requests.

## A full example

Order a number, let an SMS arrive while `waitCode` polls, check the code and the money. `addSmsAfter` delivers the SMS after a number of polls instead of after some time, so `waitCode` runs with `interval: 0` and the test takes milliseconds.

```swift
import OnlineSim
import XCTest

final class SignUpTests: XCTestCase {
    func testReceivesTheCode() async throws {
        let mock = MockOnlineSim(balance: 10)
        let client = mock.client()

        let order = try await client.numbers.getWithNumber("google", country: 44)
        XCTAssertEqual(order.number, "+44900000001")

        try mock.addSmsAfter(order.tzid, "Your Google code: 123-456", polls: 2) // the third poll sees it
        let code = try await client.numbers.waitCode(order.tzid, interval: 0)

        XCTAssertEqual(code, "123456")
        XCTAssertEqual(mock.operations().first?.status, .tzOverOk) // waitCode closed it
        XCTAssertEqual(mock.balance(), 9.8) // the price is spent once an SMS arrived
    }
}
```

The `msg` of an operation is the code by default: the first run of 4–8 digits, with spaces and dashes between digits removed (`123-456` → `123456`); a text without such a run comes back whole. `messageToCode: false` (or `fullMessage` in `waitCode`) gives the full text.

## Errors

`failNext(_:endpoint:)` makes the next request answer `{"response": code}` — the client turns it into `OnlineSimError.api` (or `.noNumber`) exactly as for the real server. Pass `endpoint` to fail only that endpoint. `failNextTransport(status:endpoint:)` makes the next request fail with a non-JSON HTTP 502 (`.transport`).

```swift
import OnlineSim
import XCTest

final class FailureTests: XCTestCase {
    func testHandlesAMissingNumberAndANetworkHiccup() async throws {
        let mock = MockOnlineSim()
        let client = mock.client()

        mock.failNext("NO_NUMBER", endpoint: "getNum.php")
        do {
            _ = try await client.numbers.get("google")
            XCTFail("expected NO_NUMBER")
        } catch OnlineSimError.noNumber {}

        mock.failNextTransport(status: 503)
        do {
            _ = try await client.user.balance()
            XCTFail("expected a transport error")
        } catch OnlineSimError.transport(_, let status, _) {
            XCTAssertEqual(status, 503)
        }

        let balance = try await client.user.balance() // one-shot
        XCTAssertEqual(balance.balance, 100)
    }
}
```

The state itself produces the real error codes too: `WARNING_LOW_BALANCE` when the balance is short, `NO_NUMBER` when `reject` matches the next number, `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY` / `ERROR_NO_SERVICE` for unknown prices, `ERROR_WRONG_TZID` for an unknown or closed operation (`next` too; `ERROR_NO_TZID` for tzid `0`), `UNDEFINED_COUNTRY` / `UNDEFINED_DAYS` for an unknown rent country or period, `TRY_AGAIN_LATER` for every refused `rent.extend`, `ERROR_NO_OPERATIONS` for an unknown rent in `rent.close`, `ERROR_WRONG_KEY` for a wrong key (HTTP 456) or no key (HTTP 200).

## Inspecting requests

`mock.requests` lists every request received: `MockRequest(method:path:query:body:)`, `path` relative to `/api/`.

```swift
import OnlineSim
import XCTest

final class RequestTests: XCTestCase {
    func testSendsRejectAsACommaList() async throws {
        let mock = MockOnlineSim()
        _ = try await mock.client().numbers.get("google", country: 44, reject: ["4470", "4471"])

        XCTAssertEqual(mock.requests, [
            MockRequest(
                method: "GET", path: "getNum.php",
                query: ["service": "google", "country": "44", "reject": "4470,4471", "lang": "en"])
        ])
    }
}
```

## Control API

| Member                                             | Description                                                                                                                        |
| -------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `client(apiKey:lang:devID:timeout:)`               | A normal `OnlineSimClient` wired to the mock.                                                                                      |
| `transport`                                        | The fake `Transport` (the mock itself).                                                                                            |
| `addSms(_ tzid:_ text:service:) throws`            | An SMS arrives now at a number operation or a rent (detected by `tzid`). Throws `MockOnlineSimError` for an unknown or closed one. |
| `addSmsAfter(_ tzid:_ text:polls:service:) throws` | The SMS arrives after `polls` state requests for `tzid` (`numbers.state`/`stateOne`, `rent.state`/`stateOne`).                     |
| `failNext(_ code:endpoint:)`                       | The next request (to `endpoint` only, e.g. `"getNum.php"`) answers `{"response": code}`.                                           |
| `failNextTransport(status:endpoint:)`              | The next request fails with a non-JSON body and HTTP `status` (default `502`).                                                     |
| `setBalance(_:)` / `balance()`                     | Set / read the total balance, USD (it includes the part frozen by open operations, as `user.balance()` reports it).                |
| `operations()` / `rents()`                         | The current number operations / open rents (`[MockOperation]`, `[MockRent]` values), for assertions.                               |
| `requests`                                         | Log of the requests received (`[MockRequest]`).                                                                                    |
| `reset()`                                          | Back to the initializer's state.                                                                                                   |

## What the mock does

- **Numbers**: `get` freezes the price; `close` after an SMS spends it, `close` without one refunds it; `ban` after an SMS answers `"0"`, like the server. Numbers are `+<country>9000000NN`, ids count from 1. `next` switches to the following SMS. The operation's `time` stays at 1200 s — there is no clock. Service ids in `tariffs` follow the alphabetical order of the slugs.
- **Rent**: `get` reserves the price (`status` `0`, `checked` `false`) and keeps the `extension` flag; the first SMS that is not `notify` confirms the rent (`status` `1`) and charges it — `addSms(tzid, text, service: "notify")` adds a notice with `code` `0` (`"0"` in `RentSms.code`) that confirms nothing. `extend` works on a confirmed rent and charges at once. `close` releases the reservation of an unconfirmed rent and gives no refund for a confirmed one. `sum` is a number in `get`/`extend` and a decimal string on the wire of `state`, like the server. SMS appear in `messages`, newest first.
- **User**: `balance` (frozen part included), a fixed profile, `setWebhookURL` accepts any `scheme://…` URL (`VALIDATION_ERROR` otherwise), `webhookLogs` lists the deliveries the mock *recorded* when an SMS arrived while a webhook URL was set — it makes no HTTP call; their `params` follow the real payload (`code` `""` without a code, rent `number` in digits without `+`, rent `timeLeft` in minutes). `paymentHistory` has no orders.
- **Free**: `free.list` returns two fixed countries (44 first) with one number and a few SMS each.
- Not imitated: anything that needs real time — the 5 s lock after `setOperationOk` (`INTERVAL_CONCURRENT_REQUESTS_ERROR`), the 10 s lock of `rent.extend`, the 120 s before an unconfirmed rent may be closed and its 20-minute wait for the first SMS. `guardInterval > 0` stands in for "too early to close".


# User

## balance

Balance in USD.

```swift
func balance() async throws -> Balance
```

`Balance`: `balance`, `zbalance`, `income?` (all `Double`). `balance` includes the sum frozen by numbers and unconfirmed rents in progress (`zbalance`, which may be negative): available = `balance − max(zbalance, 0)`. `income` is the partner income. The server caches the answer for 60 s.

```swift
let balance = try await client.user.balance()
let available = balance.balance - max(balance.zbalance, 0)
```

Errors: `.api` `ERROR_WRONG_KEY`, `ACCOUNT_BLOCKED`, `API_ACCESS_DISABLED`, `API_ACCESS_IP`.

## profile

The account profile.

```swift
func profile() async throws -> Profile
```

`Profile`: `id`, `name?`, `username?`, `email?`, `locale?`, `currency?`, `numberCountry?`, `numberReject`, `webhookURL?`, `number?` (`Int`), `country?` (`String`), `apiAccess?` (a `JSONValue`: `true` or a map of allowed IPs), …

```swift
let profile = try await client.user.profile()
print(profile.email ?? "", profile.webhookURL ?? "no webhook")
```

## paymentHistory

Top-up orders (paginated, newest first) and the available payment methods.

```swift
func paymentHistory(page: Int = 1) async throws -> PaymentHistory
```

`PaymentHistory`: `orders` (`Paginator<PaymentOrder>`), `paylist` (`[String: JSONValue]`), `domains?`, `forms?`, `currency?`, `buttons?`. `PaymentOrder.sum` stays a decimal string (`"89.00"`); `currency` and `formText` may be `nil`. `paylist` maps a group id to its payment methods; when the server sends a JSON array (ids 0, 1, 2…) its items are kept under the keys `"0"`, `"1"`, `"2"`…. `Paginator`: `currentPage`, `data`, `from?`, `to?`, `lastPage`, `perPage`, `total`, page URLs.

```swift
let orders = try await client.user.paymentHistory().orders
print("\(orders.total) orders, page \(orders.currentPage)/\(orders.lastPage)")
```

## setWebhookURL

Set the URL that receives SMS webhooks (see [Webhooks](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-swift-api/webhooks)).

```swift
func setWebhookURL(_ url: String) async throws
```

```swift
try await client.user.setWebhookURL("https://example.com/onlinesim-hook")
```

Errors: `.api` `VALIDATION_ERROR` for an invalid URL; `message` holds the server's field messages.

## clearWebhookURL

Remove the webhook URL, also from operations in progress.

```swift
func clearWebhookURL() async throws
```

```swift
try await client.user.clearWebhookURL()
```

## webhookLogs

Webhook delivery log, newest first, 10 per page.

```swift
func webhookLogs(page: Int = 1) async throws -> Paginator<WebhookLog>
```

`WebhookLog`: `id`, `userID`, `webhookURL`, `type`, `params`, `status`, `error?`, `createdAt`, `updatedAt` — `type` is `.receivingSms` or `.rentSms`, `status` is `success`, `fail` or `pending`, `params` the payload that was sent (a `WebhookPayload`).

```swift
let logs = try await client.user.webhookLogs()
for log in logs.data { print(log.createdAt, log.status, log.error ?? "") }
```


# Webhooks

Set a URL with [`client.user.setWebhookURL`](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-swift-api/user#setwebhookurl). For each SMS the server POSTs a JSON body to it: `webhook_type` `receiving_sms` for numbers, `rent_sms` for rents. Delivery attempts are listed by [`client.user.webhookLogs`](https://s00d.github.io/onlinesim-swift-api/user#webhooklogs).

## parseWebhook

Parse an inbound webhook body from the raw request body or a JSON string.

```swift
func parseWebhook(_ payload: Data) throws -> WebhookPayload
func parseWebhook(_ payload: String) throws -> WebhookPayload
```

Lenient: numeric fields may arrive as strings, missing or malformed fields become `nil`, unknown fields are dropped. It throws `OnlineSimError.invalidPayload` only when the input is not a JSON object.

Call it from the request handler of your HTTP server (Vapor, Hummingbird, …) with the body bytes:

```swift
import Foundation
import OnlineSim

func handleOnlineSimHook(body: Data) throws {
    let hook = try parseWebhook(body)
    if hook.webhookType == .receivingSms, let tzid = hook.operationID {
        print(tzid, hook.code ?? "no code")
    }
}
```

## Payload fields

| Field         | JSON key       | Type           | Description                                                                                                                  |
| ------------- | -------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `webhookType` | `webhook_type` | `WebhookType?` | `.receivingSms` or `.rentSms`.                                                                                               |
| `operationID` | `operation_id` | `Int?`         | `tzid` of the operation or rent.                                                                                             |
| `userID`      | `user_id`      | `Int?`         | Account id.                                                                                                                  |
| `countryCode` | `country_code` | `Int?`         | Country code of the number.                                                                                                  |
| `number`      | `number`       | `String?`      | Numbers: `+` and the full number (`+79001234567`), or `hidden`. Rent: the full number in digits without `+` (`79001234567`). |
| `sender`      | `sender`       | `String?`      | Sender of the SMS, e.g. `VK`.                                                                                                |
| `message`     | `message`      | `String?`      | Full SMS text.                                                                                                               |
| `code`        | `code`         | `String?`      | Code extracted from the SMS; `""` when none was found.                                                                       |
| `timeStart`   | `time_start`   | `String?`      | Numbers: when the operation was ordered. Rent: when the SMS arrived. `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`.                                  |
| `timeLeft`    | `time_left`    | `Int?`         | Time left: seconds for numbers, minutes for rent.                                                                            |
